text: Observation logging (dev/kt-observe) is installed in user scope since 2026-10-26: hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json run `python3 <repo>/dev/kt-observe/observe.py`, /kt-flag is a symlink in ~/.claude/commands. Log at ~/.claude/knowledge-track-log/ (events.jsonl + sessions/ transcript copies). Remove with `python3 dev/kt-observe/install.py --uninstall`. Moving or renaming the repo breaks the hooks silently.
